items.title: Update Alerts
items.subtitle: Apollo Reborn now tells you when an update is out and hands it to your sideloader.

items.title: Smoother Scrolling
items.subtitle: Feeds stutter less, especially deep into a feed and with keyword filters on.

items.title: Liquid Glass, Your Way
items.subtitle: Switch to the classic look under Interface > Appearance, or shrink the tab bar into a small pill as you scroll.

items.title: Fewer Rate Limits
items.subtitle: API-Key-Free accounts send fewer Reddit requests, and Reduce Rate Limiting cuts them further.

items.title: Summaries in Your Language
items.subtitle: Pick the language Apollo AI writes summaries in, on device or in the cloud.

items.title: Profiles
items.subtitle: Edit your Reddit profile right in Apollo, and find profile settings on a new User Profiles page.

items.title: Fixes Across the App
items.subtitle: Crash fixes, Google and Apple sign-in, and no forced YouTube captions on iOS 27.
